answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. What survives to the forge is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, published publicly on failure, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Work waits on the voyage until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the thread of the next round.
